run_eval_bop19_pose_test: run the BOP19 pose evaluation test script for multiple datasets using megaPose results
run_subprocess_eval_commands: run subprocess commands to execute eval_bop19_pose.py for each dataset in FILE_DICTIONARY
verify_expected_scores: verify extracted BOP19 recall scores against EXPECTED_OUTPUT values for lmo and tless datasets
extract_scores_from_logs: extract evaluation scores from log files using regex pattern matching on the last 7 lines
configure_dataset_file_dictionary: configure the FILE_DICTIONARY mapping dataset names to their corresponding CSV result filenames
